Acts,

SENATE

Islamabad,

No. F.
9(50)/2021-Legis. The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament)
received the assent of the President on 13th January, 2022 and is hereby published tor general information:
ACT No.
II OF 2022
An Act
to amend the Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018
WHEREAS,
it is expedient to amend the Juvenile Justice System Act, 2018 (XXII of 2018),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing:
It is
hereby enacted as follows:
1.
Short title and commencement. (1) This Act shall be called
the Juvenile Justice System (Amendment) Act. 2022.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.
